info.name: The Completion of the Alarm Clock

descriptions.inProgress: I received the #bSuper Alarm Clock#k from #bKevin the Soldier#k, who was at the Omega Sector, for Pink Mesoranger. Now all I have to do is deliver this to her.
descriptions.completed: #bKevin the Soldier#k made the #bsuper alarm clock#k for Pink Mesoranger, stationed at a field around Omega Sector, and I delivered it to her. Hopefully this will enable her to wake up on time.
